research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Methods and systems for construct identification and analysis describe using one or more aerial images of a construct such as a utility asset, power pole, or telephone pole to determine its location and identify adverse conditions including wood rot, arc damage, and flashing. Zeitview is researching and developing aerial image based construct identification, localization, and condition analysis for utility and infrastructure assets, focusing on defect detection and structural assessment.

overview_description.description: Zeitview is an aerial data analytics platform that provides aerial drone services for energy and infrastructure sectors. Utilizing artificial intelligence and machine learning, the company analyzes visual data to provide actionable insights, enhancing asset performance and longevity. Zeitview serves industries such as solar, wind, property management, telecommunications, and utilities. Their platform delivers fast, accurate inspections, aiming to lower costs and improve operational efficiency.
